summary: The school district emphasizes the importance of the E-Rate program for providing reliable internet services and supports its continuation.

claims.argument: Without ERATE funding we would not be able to provide students and staff with reliable internet service
claims.evidence_quote: We operate as a 1:1 device district and refresh student devices on a planned schedule, but those investments are only effective when supported by a robust wireless and LAN network. Through the E-Rate program, we have been able to build and maintain seamless Wi-Fi connectivity throughout classrooms, hallways, gyms and other learning spaces.
